name: Flight Sergeant Moyes

intro.text: Eighteen hours of seatbelt signs and a bag of peanuts. I am in the mood to be beaten fairly. Care to try?

win: Nicely done. I'll buy the first round at the Globe.
after: RAF Mount Pleasant has been the islands' main airfield since 1985. The long runway, built for the Airbridge, is one of the best the RAF has ever laid.
